displayDescription: Pop Art comic page: a bulb lights its halftone halo, BING!, ZAP!, and three wired bulbs form a connected system.
styleRenderer: Luminance-Based Halftone Shading (Canvas 2D dot radius from time-derived light field)
audioDescription: Silent. No audio track. Motion follows an authored visual cue sequence.
limitations: mo.js (@mojs/core) is not installed in node_modules, so the burst and pop effects are authored with GSAP on SVG instead. Motion is installed but not used, to keep a single property owner.
The halftone is a procedural approximation of print screening: dot radius follows a Gaussian light falloff. It does not simulate ink spread or misregistration.
Lightbulb glow is shown only through halftone luminance and a fill-colour change; there is no physical light transport.
The ink-navy page ground (#14223F and #1B2D55) is a scene-dependent choice informed by the background review. It is not an approved brand colour.

BING! uses black lettering with a cream outline and a black offset echo, instead of the illustration's red face, to keep readable contrast on the red-dotted yellow field. ZAP! uses black with a cream outline on the red panel.

Fonts are OS-bundled macOS system fonts (Impact, Chalkboard SE, Comic Sans MS, Marker Felt), declared with @font-face local() sources. No font files are bundled, so glyph metrics change if the render machine lacks them.
Rendering and browser QA were not run by the agent.
